newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil barges steady to firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil barges steady to firm.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil barge prices were steady to firmer in the ARA region on Wednesday and supply was relatively scarce, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded at $89.50 and $90 a tonne fob ARA, corresponding to levels seen towards the end of business on Tuesday.
High sulphur cargoes were heard quiet and prices pegged at around $83/$85 cif NWE.
Low sulphur straight-run markets were slightly firmer in line with crude oil futures.
Dealers said they thought an Irish cargo, due to load around August 10, was sold on Tuesday at around $107 a tonne fob NWE.
Other material was heard to have changed hands, traders said, but details were confidential.
